tasks.title: Harden browser observation freshness and recovery
tasks.objective: Make the native Chromium observation heartbeat remain fresh across service-worker restarts, browser refreshes, and transient bridge failures without weakening the existing watchdog boundary.
acceptance_criteria: A stale or missing observation is detected without treating a stale heartbeat as healthy.
Native controller recovery restores a fresh observation without requiring Tampermonkey.
Recovery does not create duplicate operations or bypass authentication boundaries.
verification: Run the targeted browser/controller recovery tests.

tasks.title: Minimize completed-response to next-prompt handoff latency
tasks.objective: Reduce unnecessary work between detected response completion and the next prompt being injected and submitted while preserving deterministic submission acknowledgement and recovery behavior.
acceptance_criteria: The normal chained-operation path avoids avoidable polling or fixed sleeps after response completion.
Completion-to-prompt-injection timing is instrumented and covered by deterministic tests.
Thinking selection, submission acknowledgement, and recovery behavior remain correct.
verification: Run the controller latency and browser-use compatibility tests.

tasks.title: Make completion evidence authoritative
tasks.objective: Ensure unattended task completion is based on reproducible repository verification and durable ledger evidence rather than model claims alone.
acceptance_criteria: A model cannot mark an unverified patch complete.
Verification failures retain the current task for repair.
Completed-task records include concrete verification evidence and remain recoverable after restart.
verification: Run the overnight engine and task-ledger tests.

tasks.title: Add deterministic-first hybrid roadmap planning
tasks.objective: Select the next executable task from a structured roadmap using deterministic dependency and safety rules first, with optional AI ranking only among eligible tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Roadmaps have stable task IDs, dependencies, acceptance criteria, verification, scope, and finite status values.
Dependency cycles, missing dependencies, invalid AI rankings, and scope escapes are rejected deterministically.
The executor receives only one selected task and never receives authority to choose the next task.
verification: Run the hybrid planner unit tests.
Run the overnight engine scheduler tests.

tasks.title: Harden provider-neutral planning and execution boundaries
tasks.objective: Keep provider-specific adapters behind explicit capability boundaries so planner and executor behavior remains provider-neutral and authorization rules remain controller-owned.
acceptance_criteria: Planner inputs and outputs are provider-neutral.
Fallback providers cannot apply repository changes directly.
Provider failures remain recoverable without transferring control-plane authority to a model.
verification: Run provider router and security boundary tests.

tasks.title: Strengthen application and website verification
tasks.objective: Extend verification so application behavior, integration failures, accessibility basics, and obvious functional regressions are tested rather than inferred from model output.
acceptance_criteria: Verification checks target observable application behavior instead of narrative claims.
Failures produce actionable evidence for the current task retry cycle.
The added checks remain bounded and deterministic for unattended operation.
verification: Run the application/web smoke tests and their targeted regressions.
